tiles.body_text:
- **Revenue retention ≠ count-based renewal rate** - Count asks "did they renew?" (yes/no), revenue asks "how much did we secure?" (£ amount). Example: 5 engagements at £100K each end, 3 renew at £30K each = 60% count renewal rate but only 18% revenue retention (£90K of £500K)
- **Timing attribution differs by metric** - Opportunities/churns use engagement END quarter (when opportunity arose), renewals revenue uses renewal START quarter (when you won). This causes retention rate and retained rev

- **Renewal Opportunities** - Total number of engagements that ended (each creates an opportunity to renew)
- **Renewals** - Number of engagements where a new engagement started within 60 days of the previous one ending
- **New Churns** - Number of engagements where 60+ days have passed since ending with no follow-up engagement
- **Renewal Rate** - Percentage of opportunities that converted to renewals (Renewals ÷ Renewal Opportunities)

- **Engagement End Quarter** - Quarter when an engagement ended (when the renewal opportunity arose)
- **Renewal Won Quarter** - Quarter when a new engagement started (when you won the renewal, used for sales performance)
- **Churn Quarter** - Quarter when a churn was confirmed (60 days after the engagement ended)
- **Engagement Status** - Current state: Active (Not Yet Ended) / In Renewal Window (0-60 days) / Renewed / Churned (60+ days, no renewal)
- **Days Since Engagement Ended** - Days from

- **Renewal Opportunities Revenue** - Total GBP value of engagements that ended (revenue at risk)
- **Renewals Revenue** - Total GBP value of NEW engagements secured (what you actually retained, not the ending engagement's value)
- **Churned Revenue** - Total GBP value of engagements that ended 60+ days ago with no follow-up (lost revenue)
- **Revenue Retention Rate** - Percentage of revenue retained (Renewals Revenue ÷ Renewal Opportunities Revenue)
